sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.coverage: scholarly works, authors, sources, institutions, topics, citations
sources.policy: metadata + open-access locators; honor current terms

sources.name: Crossref
sources.coverage: DOI metadata, references, licenses, funders, updates
sources.policy: metadata-first; abstracts may carry separate rights

sources.name: arXiv
sources.coverage: preprints and metadata, especially modern mathematics and adjacent fields
sources.mode: API / OAI-PMH / bulk metadata; S3 full text subject to terms
sources.policy: index and extract where permitted; link back for full-text downloads unless reuse license permits redistribution

sources.name: zbMATH Open
sources.coverage: mathematical publications, classifications, reviews, citation matching
sources.policy: ingest according to API terms and field-level licenses

sources.name: Wikidata / Wikimedia
sources.coverage: historical entities, works, people, dates, identifiers
sources.policy: use structured data under published Wikimedia terms and licenses

sources.name: Internet Archive and public-domain libraries
sources.coverage: historical scans, books, manuscripts, public-domain works
sources.policy: rights vary by item; store full text only when rights permit
